intro.title: Connect your Solis inverter
intro.subtitle: You need a SolisCloud API key.
intro.step1: Log in to soliscloud.com in a web browser.
intro.step2: Open Account → Basic Settings → API Management and activate the API. Copy the Key ID and Key Secret.
intro.step3: To let the app change the battery schedule, ask Solis support (a ticket at solis-service.solisinverters.com) to enable control access for your inverter.
intro.safe: The app starts in Monitor only: it shows prices and plans but does not change anything on the inverter until you switch to Automatic.

device.name: Home battery
device.noHybrid: No Solis hybrid inverter found on this SolisCloud account. The app needs an inverter with a battery; string inverters without a battery are not supported.

support.full: Supported: plans and controls the battery (6 time slots)
support.monitor: Monitor only: this firmware uses the older 3-slot schedule, which the app cannot write yet
support.unsupported: Not supported: no battery control on this inverter

device.monitorOnly: This inverter's firmware uses the older 3-slot schedule. The app can show the plan but not control the battery yet.
